description: Harper aborted the content-discovery scheduled run because Desktop Commander was not found via ToolSearch at the start of the session. Harper concluded the tool was unavailable and set state.yaml to 'aborted', then reported a failure. Desktop Commander was in fact available — it was deferred and had not yet appeared in the tool list at the moment of the ToolSearch call. The tool became available moments later when David pointed it out.
correction: Desktop Commander is always available in Jarvis sessions. When ToolSearch returns no match for mcp__Desktop_Commander__start_process, the correct response is to wait a moment and retry — or attempt the call directly — rather than aborting the run and flagging a failure to the user.
systemic_fix: Add a note to step-01-discover.md and the SLACK INTEGRATION section of content-discovery/workflow.md: if ToolSearch returns no match for Desktop Commander tools, retry once after a short wait before concluding the tool is unavailable. Deferred tools appear on a delay in Cowork sessions. Do not abort or update state.yaml to 'aborted' on a single failed ToolSearch.
